updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to query Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and receive an error

User impact: Users may be unable to query Copilot Chat and receive an error.

More info: When users attempt to query Copilot Chat, some of their queries may return no response and instead, users may receive an error that states, "Something went wrong."

Current status: Our service health monitoring alerted us to an increase in failures occurring when users attempt to query Copilot Chat. We're reviewing our service health telemetry to isolate the source of the failures, so that we can develop a mitigation plan.

Scope of impact: Any user attempting to query Copilot Chat may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Saturday, September 5, 2026, at 3:00 AM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to query Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and receive an error

User impact: Users may be unable to query Copilot Chat and receive an error.

More info: When users attempted to query Copilot Chat, some of their queries may have returned no response and instead, users may have received an error that stated, "Something went wrong."

Final status: Our review of the service health telemetry isolated that a recent configuration change caused a subset of requests to be rejected, resulting in elevated error rates and resulted in impact. We’ve since reverted the offending change and after an extended period of monitoring, we’ve confirmed that impact was remediated. 

Scope of impact: Any user who attempted to query Copilot Chat may be impacted. 

Start time: Saturday, September 5, 2026, at 12:40 AM UTC

End time: Saturday, September 5, 2026, at 2:09 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent configuration change caused a subset of query requests to be rejected, resulting in elevated error rates and resulted in impact.

Next steps: We'll review our service update validation process to ensure similar instances aren't replicated in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
